mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, b.isbn, b.categories, b.summary, b.cover_url, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'AVAILABLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS available_copies FROM books b LEFT JOIN book_inventory i ON b.id = i.book_id WHERE b.is_deleted = 0 AND b.id = #{id} GROUP BY b.id, b.title, b.author, b.isbn, b.categories, b.summary, b.cover_url LIMIT 1
